cues.show: You at the mic, the run on the staff on screen.
cues.say: A run is a quick line of notes sung on one breath. This tool plays one, and moves it a little higher on every pass.

cues.show: Tap the notes of the run slowly, singing each on its name.
cues.say: Learn the notes first. Tap each note on the staff and sing it on its note name, as slowly as you like.

cues.show: Press the Play button and listen to one pass.
cues.say: Press the Play button below to hear the run. The microphone starts with it.

cues.show: Press the Play button and listen to one pass.
cues.say: The line above the staff says which pass you are on.

cues.show: Sing along for a few passes. Point at your line.
cues.say: Sing along on the note names. Your line shows your voice against the notes.

cues.show: Sing along for a few passes. Point at your line.
cues.say: Every note gets its own small pulse of breath, so each one is clear and none slides into the next.

cues.show: Stop when it gets high. Press Stop.
cues.say: Each pass is a little higher than the last.

cues.show: Stop when it gets high. Press Stop.
cues.say: _Don't reach for high notes: press Stop when your voice stops feeling easy._

cues.show: Stop when it gets high. Press Stop.
cues.say: Practice until every note of the run is clear at the passes that are comfortable for you.

cues.show: Sing it on "oo", then with Tune muted, then with a bounce.
cues.say: Try things with it. Sing the run on "oo", then on "ee".

cues.show: Sing it on "oo", then with Tune muted, then with a bounce.
cues.say: Press Tune below to mute the run and sing it over what is left.

cues.show: Sing it on "oo", then with Tune muted, then with a bounce.
cues.say: Sing it with a little laugh on each note, then as smoothly as you can.

cues.show: Sing it on "oo", then with Tune muted, then with a bounce.
cues.say: Then sing only the way up, hold the top note, and come down on the next pass.
